On prod, `docker compose run app` without APP_IMAGE uses a stale local :latest (2026-03-15). Always `export APP_IMAGE=$(cat .last_deploy_image)` first (docs/deploy.md 'Article archive').
Before tagging run `git fetch --tags` and take the next free number (v0.1.125 was tagged by another session).
